card: Splits the monolithic test_IsStandard unit test into independent test cases per policy rule and moves them to a new dedicated file, transaction_standardness_tests.cpp. It replaces mutable global variables with an explicit StandardPolicy struct and builds fresh transactions declaratively for each assertion. This is an internal test cleanup supporting issue #36692 with no functional changes to mempool policy.
changed_since_previous: Moved the refactored test suite and helpers out of `src/test/transaction_tests.cpp` into a new dedicated test file `src/test/transaction_standardness_tests.cpp`.
evidence: Part of issue #36692 ("Declarative construction of test data"), aiming to eliminate shared mutated test fixtures.
problem: Tests for transaction standardness previously mutated a single shared transaction sequentially across different policy checks while relying on mutable global fee and policy settings. This coupled tests together, carried hidden state across assertions, and left standardness tests mixed in with transaction serialization tests.

risk.why: Only touches unit tests and test CMakeLists; mistakes could cause false test failures or leave standardness regressions undetected.

summary: Splits the monolithic `test_IsStandard` unit test into independent test cases for each mempool policy rule and moves them from `transaction_tests.cpp` to a dedicated `transaction_standardness_tests.cpp` file. Replaces static mutable globals with an explicit `StandardPolicy` struct and constructs test transactions declaratively per check using new `MakeTx` and `CheckDustThreshold` helpers.
